prompt: Create a highly engaging vertical short-form advertising video, 9:16 aspect ratio, about {ChuDe}.
- Adorable Vietnamese chibi characters with round faces, rosy cheeks, big expressive eyes, small bodies and exaggerated facial expressions.
- Traditional tiled-roof wooden houses, bamboo fences, banana trees, clay pots, wooden tables and baskets.
- Bright warm sunlight, cinematic soft lighting, vibrant natural colors.
- Very detailed textures, charming miniature-world feeling.
- Product/food is oversized compared to the characters to create visual impact.
Start immediately with a surprising or visually impressive moment.
Show an enormous {SanPham} appearing in the middle of the village.
The chibi characters look shocked and excited.
“Ủa! Cái gì mà to dữ vậy!”
Characters quickly gather around the product.
Show energetic actions such as carrying ingredients, opening packages, pouring, mixing, assembling, harvesting or preparing.
Show hands, ingredients and product details clearly.
Steam, particles, splashes or small visual effects should make the scene feel alive.
Make it extremely attractive, clean and visually satisfying.
Slow-motion camera movement around the product.
Characters celebrate, clap, jump or raise their hands.
Use macro close-ups of important details:
Show the characters using, eating, testing or enjoying the product.
Expressions should instantly show satisfaction and excitement.
Place the product prominently in the center foreground.
Add a clean wooden sign or attractive 3D text:
End with a cheerful pose and a slight camera pull-back.
- Push-in, orbit shot, low-angle product shot and macro close-ups.
- Smooth motion, no sudden camera glitches.
- Use shallow depth of field for close-up shots.
- Characters should move naturally but with cute exaggerated animation.
- Product must remain visually consistent throughout the entire video.
- Avoid distorted hands, duplicated characters, floating objects or inconsistent clothing.
- Light percussion and playful sound effects.
- Natural ambience such as birds, cooking sounds or village atmosphere when appropriate.
Do not copy any existing character, logo or copyrighted scene.
Use the same storytelling rhythm and cute miniature Vietnamese countryside concept, but create completely original characters and content.
Ultra-detailed 3D animation, cinematic lighting, smooth motion, high visual consistency, optimized for TikTok, Facebook Reels and YouTube Shorts.
